android.name: GATEWISE Guard (Android)
android.description: Native Android Guard client with real-time YuNet edge camera detection, SFace 128-D cosine match, and HMAC-SHA256 non-repudiation ledger.
android.install_guide: Enable 'Install from Unknown Sources' in Android Settings -> Security, open downloaded APK, and tap Install.

ios.name: GATEWISE Guard (iOS)
ios.description: Pure native SwiftUI & Swift 6 client with Liquid Glass aesthetic, strict concurrency, biometric Face ID unlock, and offline-first persistence.
ios.install_guide: Install via TestFlight, institutional Apple Configurator 2, AltStore, SideStore, or mobile device management (MDM) profile.

macos.name: GATEWISE Admin Command Centre (macOS)
macos.compatibility: macOS 13.0 Ventura, Sonoma, Sequoia (Apple Silicon & Intel)
macos.description: Native desktop Command Centre for campus administrators with live telemetry, access roster control, and cryptographic audit log inspection.
macos.install_guide: Open the DMG disk image, drag 'GATEWISE AI Command Centre.app' into Applications, and launch.
